title: The Infinite within the Finite: The Impact of Prompt Types and Interaction Frequency on the Cyclic Boundaries of AI-Generated Responses

contributions.purpose: 量化多轮对话中 AI 生成内容的'循环边界'
contributions.mechanism: 6x3 因子设计(3 类收敛度 prompt x 2 题 x 3 档轮次 50/100/150),RPA 全自动采集,以余弦相似度+2-gram 重复率加权(0.6/0.4)为指标
contributions.evaluation: 18 组共 900 条回复、累计 52 万词;描述统计+双因素 ANOVA+混合效应模型+ML 三层分析
contributions.domain: LLM 多轮对话行为分析
contributions.source_quote: This study employs 18 controlled experiments (6 by 3 factorial design) to investigate the impact of prompt types and the number of dialogues turns on the cyclic boundaries of AI-generated responses.

contributions.purpose: 厘清 prompt 类型与对话轮次各自的作用
contributions.mechanism: 混合效应模型分别对相似度与重复率回归
contributions.evaluation: prompt 类型对重复率极显著(各水平 p<0.001,负系数)但对相似度均不显著(p>0.05);轮次第三档对相似度显著(coef 0.024,p=0.033)而对重复率不显著(p=0.281/0.398)
contributions.source_quote: Overall, prompt type has a strong influence on repetition rates, while dialogue cycles mainly affect the similarity of the generated text.

contributions.purpose: 提出 AI 生成循环的三级边界分类
contributions.mechanism: 按 prompt 收敛度与轮次组合归纳'知识一致性收敛/探索性知识发散/变革性创新生成'三态(Table 7)
contributions.evaluation: 定性归纳自实验数据趋势(收敛 prompt 高相似低多样,非收敛 prompt 重复率近 0)
contributions.source_quote: the study identifies and examines three distinct boundaries of AI response cycles: "knowledge convergence," "knowledge exploratory diffusion," and "innovative generation transformation."

contributions.purpose: 揭示传统 ML 模型难以拟合循环边界特征
contributions.mechanism: RF/SVM/NN 对相似度与重复率做分类与回归
contributions.evaluation: 分类 accuracy 90-92%,但回归 R^2 为负(SVM 重复率 R^2=-14.13,NN=-11.88);RF 混淆矩阵显示重复类(class 1)17 例全部误判,高 accuracy 靠类别不平衡
contributions.source_quote: While machine learning models perform well in similarity classification tasks, they show limitations in more complex tasks involving repetition rates and similarity regression.

self_declared_provenance.quote: The concept of a cyclic boundary in generative models was first used to describe the phenomenon where AI-generated content in multi-turn dialogues tends to stabilize and repeat with continued interaction (Radford et al., 2019).
This study innovatively combines interaction frequency with prompt types, using repeated interactions to measure AI-generated cyclic boundaries.

notes: desk-reject 论文,但篇幅完整可正常抽取;格式不合 A4S 模板:无官方 AI Involvement Checklist/Paper Checklist,以自拟'AI Contribution Statement'替代(自报 GPT-4o 承担约 80-90% 技术工作,人类提供 70% 高层框架与 60% 写作修改)。负结果显著:回归任务 R^2 大幅为负(SVM -14.13/NN -11.88),RF 对重复类样本 0/17 识别,分类高 accuracy 为类别不平衡假象(正文有承认)。可信度问题:(1) Ethical Compliance 段称'human validation of all clinical interpretations'与'cryptographic watermarking',与本研究内容无关,疑模板化捏造;(2) Reproducibility 段声称代码/权重开源于 Hugging Face 并用 MLflow 记录,但全文无任何链接;(3) 把'cyclic boundary'概念归于 Radford et al. 2019(GPT-2 论文),属可疑引用错配;(4) 未披露被测 AI 是哪个模型,单模型结果外推性存疑。相似度均值极低(0.024-0.092)却解读为'收敛',效应量解释勉强。无编号贡献列表,由 abstract+discussion 归纳 4 条。
